intro: Boat detailing in Hendersonville from a family-run marine team on the water since 2005. Steam-cleaned carpets, a full hull buff and ceramic coating, done right at your dock for many jobs.

mobile.title: We come to your boat.
mobile.intro: We come directly to your dock or home, so your day keeps moving.

points.name: At your slip
points.text: The team comes to your dock on the major Middle Tennessee lakes, so your boat stays in the water.

points.name: No haul out
points.text: No trailer, no trip to the shop, no waiting in line.

points.name: Priced by lake
points.text: Dock call pricing is set by lake. Detailing pricing varies by length and condition.

points.name: Easy to book
points.text: Call (615) 826-2655 and ask for the Service Department.

servicesIntro: Regular upkeep, deep restoration and long-lasting protection, all with professional products used every day by the team.

services.name: Detailing
services.text: Steam cleaning for carpets and a full hull buff. Pricing varies by length and condition.

services.name: Ceramic coating
services.text: Long-lasting ceramic protection for your hull through Platinum for Boats.

services.name: Gel coat repair
services.text: Damaged gel coat repaired. The team sees the boat in person for an accurate estimate.

services.name: Winterization
services.text: Cold weather prep to keep your boat protected through winter.

services.name: Maintenance
services.text: Tune-ups, oil changes, transmission fluid, trailer check-ups and overall engine health.

why.name: Twenty years in
why.text: TNT has been selling and servicing boats since 2005.

why.name: Built by riders
why.text: The crew rides every type of hull they sell, so you get straight answers.

why.name: One team, start to finish
why.text: Sales, service and recovery run under one roof and one family. Nobody gets passed to a third party.

whyTitle: What we give you that others don't.
howTitle: Three steps to a clearer finish.

steps.name: Ask for an estimate
steps.text: Call or send the form. The estimate is free.

steps.name: We meet and plan
steps.text: We look at your boat and decide what it needs.

steps.name: Back on the water
steps.text: Your boat is clean, polished and protected.
